create_event_from_dict: create an Event object from a dictionary using the from_dict class method
extract_word_and_phoneme_sequence_info: extract word index and phoneme id sequence info from an events DataFrame
create_blocks_from_events: create blocks from an events DataFrame grouped by sentence, sound, or fixation
merge_blocks_by_duration: merge consecutive blocks until they reach a minimum duration threshold
assign_blocks_to_splits: randomly assign blocks to train validation and test splits by ratio
